quotes.excerpt: I use a lot of different harnesses, so in CC i use sonnet as main w/ opus advisor, in codex i use astra all the time, in obvious I usually use the GLM models. In general I've found that having a fast main model with a big smart advisor is a nice UX if I'm going to be on keyboard interacting with it, for a long-running agent that I'm not attending to I care much less about the main model speed and more about cost/qual
